blocks.t: o nS ee ~ After having extracted the game from the box, assemble the base with levelling feet through the fastening screws of the base.
- The chain beneath the cabinet is connected on earth and is foreseen for an eventual installation in areas with synthetic car-— peting. It is suggested not to remove it.

- Open back door to extract power supply cable. ~- Before connecting the game some inspections should be madee These visual inspections are important for the damages which might have been caused curing transport.
1. Check that all connectors are connected
2. Check that all mechanical parts are in correct position.
3. Check that safety switch at the bottom back board works correctly and that is to say: When assembling back door and tlosing it slowly one should hear the microswitch contact shut off.

4. Check that the game is programmed for the right available voltage( games are factory programmed for 220V. for all european countries except GB. for 245V.) 5 Make sure that earth socket is connected.
The CRT used in our games is like those emploied on regular television sets, therefore, please handle with care so as not to damage ite
- [To not set up the game in open and very lighted areas, as the quality of image would be greatly damaged.

- Do not set up the game close to heating sources and keep it 10 cm. from the beck wall. ~- If, when game is on, no image appears on the screen, check power supply fuses and if connectors are properly connected.
- If the screen is lit up but there is no image,check that C.P.U. board connectors are properly connected.

- If the image slowly moves toward the side, it can be caused by a close magnet or by a transformer which might cause strong wavinesses. If the games is turmed around itself on power on, it might happen that the image on the screen will chcenge colour.This is caused by the earth magetic filed. To have the right colours again, only turn off the game for 5 minutes and then turn it on again. PLEASE DO NOT CHANGE THE IMMATRICULATION LABELS BOTH ON THE CABINET AND ON THE ELECTRONIC BOARDS TO AVOID DISCUSSIONS IN CASE OF SERVICING.
